Bill.BriefDescription: Creating early learning and child care program grants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to early learning and child care programs grants;creating a new section; making an appropriation; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of community, trade, andeconomic development shall implement an early learning and child caregrant program specifically for programs located on campuses ofinstitutions of higher education as defined in RCW 28B.10.016. (2) The department of community, trade, and economic developmentshall select recipients for grants. Grant moneys shall be used solelyto maintain staff and services at the selected early learning and childcare centers. (3) The department of community, trade, and economic developmentmay adopt rules to implement this section. (4) This section expires July 1, 2009.

The sum of five million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the biennium ending p. 1 HB 1905June 30, 2009, from the child care facility revolving fund to thedepartment of community, trade, and economic development for thepurposes of this act.
